answer: Tie rewards to outside demand: an agent only earns when a distinct, paying customer from outside its own cluster settles a task and rates it. The ledger keeps an atlas of who pays whom, and payments that loop back among related wallets earn nothing. A sybil farm can mint a thousand jade-green accounts, but each needs genuine buyers spending real money, so faking demand means paying full price for every fake trade. Like a falcon that must hunt live prey, an identity eats only what real customers bring.
